overview: Palau is an island country in the western Pacific, made up of about 340 islands. Its capital is Ngerulmud, and its largest town is Koror. Palau became independent in 1994 and has a close association with the United States. In 2009 it created the world's first shark sanctuary.

geography.text: Palau has volcanic islands, such as Babeldaob, the largest, and many limestone islands. The Rock Islands, small mushroom-shaped islands covered in forest, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its coral reefs and clear water make it one of the best places in the world for diving.

history.text: Palau was settled thousands of years ago. It was ruled by Spain and Germany and then by Japan, which made Koror an important administrative centre. After fierce fighting on the island of Peleliu in 1944, it became part of a UN trust territory run by the United States. Palau became independent in 1994, in free association with the US.

events.title: Battle of Peleliu
events.text: US forces capture Peleliu after one of the war's hardest battles.

events.title: Shark sanctuary
events.text: Palau creates the world's first shark sanctuary.

government.text: Palau is a presidential republic. The President, elected every four years, is head of state and government. Its Congress has two chambers. Under a Compact of Free Association, the United States is responsible for Palau's defence.

economy.text: Tourism, especially diving, is Palau's main industry, along with US aid. Palau makes visitors sign a pledge to protect its environment when they arrive.

culture.text: Palau is known for its Rock Islands, hundreds of small limestone islands covered in forest. Jellyfish Lake is filled with millions of jellyfish that have lost most of their sting. Palau created the world's first shark sanctuary in 2009.

items.title: Palau Pledge
items.text: Visitors promise to protect the islands, stamped in their passport.

sport.text: Baseball, introduced during Japanese rule, is the most popular sport. Swimming and athletics are also popular.

items.title: Baseball
items.text: Brought to Palau during Japanese rule.
